svg.desc: Lasutriv. ROLE: Game developer · autonomous AI agents. LATEST: Monarchy · New Roots. ASSET: AIA-Evolve, an AI agent that ships code 24/7. A constructivist poster: sunburst rays, a giant black name on a diagonal, three cut bars, a red wedge and a stamp ring reading DECLASSIFIED.
